name: Danganronpa: New World Order
source:
Danganronpa: New World Order is a game created by Alpha Team based on the Danganronpa video game series. 16 families rule over different aspects of the world. After the heads of the houses are killed in a Killing Game, a talent search is launched to find the new leaders to take over the houses. The leading candidates are kidnapped and placed into a Killing Game.

[From [url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/DanganronpaNewWorldOrder]TV Tropes[/url]]
translation: 《Danganronpa: New World Order》是Alpha Team基于《弹丸论破》系列创作的游戏。16个家族分别统治着世界的不同领域。各家族首领在一场自相残杀游戏中遇害后，众人开始寻找新的领袖接管家族。最有希望的候选人遭到绑架，被迫参加一场自相残杀游戏。[引自[url=https://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/VisualNovel/DanganronpaNewWorldOrder]TV Tropes[/url]]
